name: repo_bench_dedup
description: A deduplicated snapshot of code repositories intended for benchmarking code-model performance and for research into dataset deduplication effects. The dataset primarily supports tasks around code retrieval, generation, and evaluation after removing near-duplicate examples from training corpora. It is useful for more realistic evaluation of code models by reducing contamination between train and test data.
reputation: An ad-hoc, community-contributed deduplicated repo snapshot; useful for research but with limited formal adoption or benchmarking history.
